hook_line: PLAN TO END H-1B GRACE PERIOD DRAWS 31,383 PUBLIC COMMENTS BEFORE DEADLINE

hook_stat.sub: Public comments posted on the DHS proposal to eliminate the 60-day grace period

stats.label: Of H-1B petitions approved in fiscal 2025 were for workers born in India
Current grace period after a job loss, still in effect today

diaspora_bullets: Indian professionals would carry most of the impact if the rule is finalised
The grace period remains in effect until DHS publishes a final rule
news_summary: A Department of Homeland Security proposal to eliminate the 60-day grace period after a job loss drew 31,383 posted public comments before the November 10 deadline, while the grace period remains in effect.
payoff: Nothing changes today: a worker laid off this week still has the grace period, because the proposal has no legal effect until DHS publishes a final rule.
